app.name: Haqdaar.ai
app.tagline: Find the government schemes you are entitled to
app.disclaimer: An independent academic project, not affiliated with any government body. Always confirm eligibility with the official scheme authority before applying.

home.title: Know what you are entitled to
home.subtitle: Tell us about yourself and we will find the welfare schemes you qualify for. Answer only what you want to.

privacy.notice: Nothing you enter is saved. Your answers stay in this browser and are never stored.

profile.heading: About you
profile.intro: Every question is optional. The more you answer, the more we can tell you.

field.isMinority: Do you belong to a religious minority?
field.isBPL: Do you hold a Below Poverty Line (BPL) card?

results.expired: We don't keep your answers, so we can't reopen your results. It only takes a minute to fill in again.
results.heading: What we found
results.summary: {pass} you qualify for, {unknown} you may qualify for, out of {total} schemes checked.
results.empty: Tell us a little about yourself to see schemes.
results.passHint: Every criterion we can check is met.
results.unknownHint: We cannot tell yet. Some criteria could not be checked automatically.
results.failHint: At least one criterion is not met.
results.showFailed: Show {count} schemes you are not eligible for

question.heading: One more question would help
question.unblocks: Answering this could decide {count} more schemes.

voice.heading: Or just speak
voice.intro: Tell us about yourself in your own words. We will fill in the form and you can correct anything before it is used.
voice.reviewHeading: Please check these before we use them
voice.reviewIntro: We filled these in from what you said. Change anything that is wrong, then confirm.
voice.nothingFound: We could not pick out any details from that. Try again, or fill the form in yourself.
voice.dropped: We ignored {count} value(s) we could not hear you say.
voice.unavailable: Voice input is not available right now.
voice.unavailableHint: The form below works exactly the same. Nothing is lost.
voice.permissionDenied: We could not use your microphone. Check your browser permission, or fill the form in below.
voice.notSupported: This browser cannot record audio. Please fill the form in below.
